legend.transport.flightsNote: Trails use rotating colors; the colors do not indicate categories
legend.transport.histNote1: 3D trails shade from blue to white by observed altitude; the altitude exaggeration is visual only and does not change the data.
legend.transport.histNote2: Gaps between observations are joined by straight lines, which do not mean measured data exist in between. The number of gaps is shown in the popup.
legend.transport.railNoteMetro: Metro lines use their official line colors
legend.transport.portsNote: Colors follow the source port_class; missing values are not treated as any existing class
legend.transport.osmNote: Shown at z≥10 | Source: OpenStreetMap | 550k edges
legend.transport.roadEvNote: ⚠ live_city is skewed toward Keelung; Kaohsiung has no TDX source
legend.transport.cctvNote: Shown at z≥7 | Click to see the live image
legend.transport.freewayNote: TDX segment congestion levels, played along the timeline
legend.transport.satNote1: ● Live point = directly below the satellite (sub-satellite point)
legend.transport.satNote2: ● Inner circle: 50 km swath (indicative imaging footprint)
legend.transport.satNote3: ● Dashed outer circle: 1,500 km (visibility cone at elevation ≥ 10°)
legend.transport.satNote4: ● Track = ground track for the next 30 minutes
legend.transport.aviFir: FIR flight information region (3), outline only
legend.transport.aviNote1: ● Source: Civil Aeronautics Administration eAIP AIRAC 01-26 (2026-03-19)
legend.transport.aviNote2: ● Applies to crewed aircraft (Civil Aeronautics Act §43); differs from the 🛸 drone rules
legend.transport.aviNote3: ● Click a polygon to see its floor/ceiling altitudes
legend.transport.droneRed: 2026-06-30 reference polygons (red + unclassified, 5,635; current rules not verified)
legend.transport.droneYellow: 2026-06-30 yellow-zone reference polygons (108; current rules not verified)
legend.transport.droneNote2: ● Hidden below z 7 so that large blocks do not cover the map
legend.transport.droneNote3: ● Click a polygon to see penalties / competent authority
legend.transport.parkOnstreet: Taipei on-street: capacity only (darker = more), no live vacancy
